Resolves #20254

A link whose text is a code span, `[`name`](url)`, renders as written again instead of a bold `NEO_INLINE_CODE_n`. `Markdown#modifyMarkdown` now restores its protection tokens newest first, so a link is back in the content before the code span it holds. The regression came with #19912, and on neomjs.com it shows in 6 published posts (18 links).

Evidence: L2 (unit spec red → green, plus a real-browser render of a published post served from this branch) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: AC-3 is post-deploy (Post-Merge Validation).

Micro-review eligible: restoration — one loop order and its comment in `src/component/Markdown.mjs`, plus one spec.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `Markdown.spec.mjs` › "a code span inside a Markdown link stays part of that link". It was red on the unfixed source ("the link is left as written") and is green at `612298624d` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the existing `Markdown.spec.mjs` cases, including #19912's link case and #18675's `$` case: 7 passed |
| AC-3 | Post-merge: the deployed portal (Post-Merge Validation); the pre-merge render is in Test Evidence |
